title: API Response Codes and Error Messages

blocks.text: The following HTTP status codes are returned by the API:

table: Successful and a new resource is created
Request accepted. The request has been received, but not completed yet.

Forbidden This code is returned for one of the following reasons: The API key was disabled by your service provider. The user's role has no access permissions. A required SKU subscription is missing. Contact Zscaler Support or your Zscaler Account team for assistance.
